name: block-collection-and-party trigger queries
description: Should trigger when the user wants an existing implementation to start from: a Block Collection block, a Block Party block, plugin, build tooling or integration, or the authored markup of a reference block. Near misses: writing a block from a given model, content modeling, finding pages, import, dev server, review.

queries.query: We need a carousel for product images. Before writing one from scratch, check whether there is an existing implementation we can adapt for this repo.
Our designers want Sass for the block CSS during local development. Is there an existing EDS setup for that we can copy instead of building our own?
We want breadcrumbs on every page below /products. Is there something existing in the Adobe or community collections to start from?
Is there a community Sidekick plugin that shows all pages of a section so reviewers can open them quickly? Find one we could add to the repo.
Authors want an FAQ section with click-to-expand questions. Find an existing block we can start from and tell me where it lives.
Show me the authored table structure and variants of the standard `accordion` block from Adobe's reference, so my test content matches what the block expects.
Is there a ready-made EDS integration for a cookie consent banner that other teams already use? I want something to adapt, not to design.
Start a new `tabs` block in this repo from the standard reference implementation, then I'll adjust the labels.
Authors will write a new `stats` block as a table: a number column and a label column, one row per stat. Write the decorate function and CSS for that block so it works with exactly that markup.
We need a testimonials block. Propose the content model: what an author types into the table, which cells are optional, and how it behaves with one or five quotes.
Which existing pages on our site already use the `cards` block, and with which variants? I want to test a change against them.
Import https://www.example.com/pricing into our EDS site as a new page.
`aem up` dies immediately with EADDRINUSE and I have no idea what is on the port. How do I get the dev server running?
Please review PR #214 on our EDS repo. Someone added a tabs block and I want to make sure it follows our conventions. Just leave comments, don't push changes.
In vanilla JS, what's the cleanest way to debounce a resize handler? No need to look at any repo.
